data.description:
## Context

The code-review Pass-2 verifier prompt (`src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md`) asks `cited_reference_accurate` with the same unscoped wording that made the plan-review verifier veto correct findings (bug doglike-gossipy-pussycat): "answer it only when the finding cites a specific `path:line`". A `no` feeds the same `pass3_decide` veto. When a code-review finding reports that the change under review cites a wrong location (a stale line reference in a doc, a test path that does not exist), the verifier may check the change's citation, find it wrong, and veto the correct finding.

No code-review drop of this shape has been measured yet; code-review verdicts live with the review-bot, not in the tickets store.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Code-review verdict records are checked for `veto:cited-reference-inaccurate` drops whose finding reports a wrong citation in the change, with a count.
- [ ] If any are found, `code-review-verify.md` gets the same whose-citation scoping as the plan-review verifier prompts, with a live regression test; if none, the measurement is recorded and the ticket closed.
data.title: Code-review verifier: scope cited_reference_accurate to the finding's own citation
